description: This Java class defines the default configuration for rate limiting, specifically for throttling connection recovery. It reads configuration parameters such as frequency and entity amount from a configuration source, and provides methods to access these parameters, as well as standard overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultRateConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ReconnectConfig.RateConfig, holding rate configuration parameters such as frequency and entity amount.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultRateConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency Duration for reconnection attempts.

methods.name: getEntityAmount
methods.description: Returns the number of entities involved in the rate limit.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on frequency and entityAmount.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash based on frequency and entityAmount.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration.
